name: Fantasy Book Writer
description: AI-assisted fantasy book writing with structured organization, world-building, and token-budgeted context generation

cli-commands.name: writer init
cli-commands.description: Initialize a new book project with folder structure

cli-commands.name: writer create-part
cli-commands.description: Create a new part (story arc) with auto-numbering

cli-commands.name: writer create-chapter
cli-commands.description: Create a new chapter within a part

cli-commands.name: writer create-scene
cli-commands.description: Create a new scene within a chapter

cli-commands.name: writer create-world-rule
cli-commands.description: Create an immutable world rule or law

cli-commands.name: writer create-nation
cli-commands.description: Create an expandable nation or political entity

cli-commands.name: writer init-baseline
cli-commands.description: Initialize book baseline (world state at book start)

cli-commands.name: writer validate
cli-commands.description: Validate book structure, references, and metadata

cli-commands.name: writer add-fact
cli-commands.description: Append content to an append-only or expandable fact

cli-commands.name: writer lock-fact
cli-commands.description: Lock an expandable fact to immutable

cli-commands.name: writer generate-context
cli-commands.description: Generate token-budgeted context files for AI writing

cli-commands.name: writer build
cli-commands.description: Build project: validate, generate context, analyze

cli-commands.name: writer analyze
cli-commands.description: Run analysis: character graph, timeline, word counts

cli-commands.name: writer export
cli-commands.description: Export manuscript to markdown or HTML
